issue_context.title: Overwritting the "toString" field in the JSON
issue_context.body:
### Bug Description

It seems that n8n is omitting the field named `toString` when parsing the data.

For example, given an object like:
```
{
    from: 123,
    fromString: "Some from string",
    to: 456,
    toString: "Some to string"
}
```
the n8n is parsing it into:
```
{
    from: 123,
    fromString: "Some from string",
    to: 456
}
```

I assume this is happening because there is also a JS built-in `toString` function so it gets overwritten or omitted.

### To Reproduce

We're facing this issue as we're trying to consume Jira's API, specifically this API endpoint: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issues/#api-rest-api-3-issue-issueidorkey-changelog-get

which in its response is returning an object similar to the one from the bug description above.

### Expected behavior

n8n shouldn't omit the `toString` field from the JSON object.

### Operating System

MacOS 14.4.1

### n8n Version

1.72.1

### Node.js Version

20.18.0

### Database

SQLite (default)

### Execution mode

main (default)
